The warning is right, but it understates things. The app's menus aren't waiting for the new behaviour. On main they're probably already broken.

## Why this is live now
The app doesn't keep its own copy of the design system. `server/main.js:58-62` and `:74` serve `/system/` directly from `prelude/prelude-design-system/system/`, and every page that uses the system loads `/system/components.css` (`server/views/_head.eta:16`). PR #53 is merged, so the app is already using the new menu CSS.

The new CSS (`prelude/prelude-design-system/system/components.css:264-298`) only places a `.menu-list` that has `[popover]`. That covers the anchoring, floating above panels and flipping to where there's room. The old `details.menu` rules are gone, and no other stylesheet in `server/public` or the shell's `layouts/` brings them back. A `<details class="menu">` still opens and closes, but its list should now appear in the normal page flow, pushing the toolbar and content around instead of floating. I haven't run the app to see this, so that's worth checking.

## What still uses `<details>`
The agent's count of 13 is wrong: there are **11** menus in `server/views/`:
- `_design-bar.eta`: 5 menus (lines 73, 90, 131 Capture, 160, 188)
- `_bar.eta:13` (projects), `_agents.eta:5` (running)
- `_chat.eta:19` (sessions), `_dictation.eta:36` (speech model, `.up`)
- `_page-menu.eta:9`, `_review-menu.eta:5`

The shell design has the same two as the app: `prelude/prelude-shell/layouts/_bar.eta` and `_agents.eta`.

Two pieces of script depend on `<details>` too, not just the one the warning names:
- `server/public/desktop.js:69-70` finds the menu with `closest('details')` and closes it with `menu.open = false`.
- Five `ko-set="….open = false"` close a menu when a row is used: `_bar.eta:17,22`, `_agents.eta:9`, `_design-bar.eta:139,144` and `_dictation.eta:40`. `.open` doesn't exist on a popover, so these do nothing once the menus move.

## What I'd change (on a branch)
- **The 11 views:** change `<details class="menu …">` to `<div class="menu …">`, and the `<summary class="btn …">` to `<button type="button" popovertarget ko-for="name">`. Put `ko-as="name" popover` on the `.menu-list`. This follows `system/components/menu.html` and Koda's `ko-for` (reference.md, "ko-for – the target by name"). Move each existing `ko-as` (`projects`, `running`, `captureMenu`, `modelMenu`) from the wrapper to the list. Capture's form already has `id="capture-form"`, so that's the one place an id could be used directly.
- **Closing on a row:** remove the `ko-set="x.open = false"` attributes. Links that go to a new page don't need them. Rows that submit in place are a different case. The design system's NOTES.md (line 135) points out that a menu stays open unless the response replaces it. For those, use Koda's `hide-popover` command (reference.md:1565), or let the region refresh replace the menu.
- **`desktop.js`:** find the menu with `button.closest('[popover]')` and close it with `?.hidePopover()`. The two-frame wait before the capture can stay.
- **Shell:** make the same change in `prelude/prelude-shell/layouts/_bar.eta` and `_agents.eta`, so the shell design stays in step with the app.
- **NOTES.md:** correct the "13" to 11 at line 132, and remove that open question once the views have moved.

The snapshots that contain `<details class="menu">` are renders of these views. They'll update when the designs are next rendered, so there's nothing to edit in them by hand.
